observations: Photo 0 shows a large, cream-colored hair dryer hood with a dark grey lower section.
The brand 'EQUATOR' and model 'EQUATOR 2' are clearly visible on a label on the top of the hood in photos 0 and 1.
The hood is mounted on a black metal stand.
A white handheld hair dryer is visible to the right of the hood, resting on a salon chair.
The hood appears to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible cracks or significant wear.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hood may have a faulty thermostat or safety switch.
risks.proof: A video showing the hood cycling on and off automatically.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
